nodes.title: Bad parameter set

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Hausdorff, second-countable smooth manifold without boundary modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space, and let $f : M \to \mathbb{R}^n$ be a map. The critical set of $f$ is the set of points $x \in M$ at which the manifold derivative of $f$ at $x$, a linear map $T_xM \to \mathbb{R}^n$, is not surjective.
nodes.title: Critical points of a map to Euclidean space

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Hausdorff, second-countable smooth manifold without boundary modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space, and let $f : M \to \mathbb{R}^n$ be a map. The set of critical values of $f$ is the image under $f$ of its critical set, the set of points $x \in M$ at which the manifold derivative of $f$ at $x$ is not surjective.
nodes.title: Critical values of a map to Euclidean space

nodes.title: Parametric Sard theorem for real analytic families

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be finite-dimensional real normed spaces, let $\mu$ be an additive Haar measure on $F$ with its Borel $\sigma$-algebra, let $U \subseteq E$ be open, and let $g : E \to F$ be $C^\infty$ on $U$. Then the image under $g$ of the set of points $x \in U$ at which the derivative of $g$ is not surjective has $\mu$-measure zero.
nodes.title: Sard's theorem on open subsets of finite-dimensional spaces

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a Hausdorff, second-countable smooth manifold without boundary modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space, and let $f : M \to \mathbb{R}^n$ be a $C^\infty$ map. Then the set of critical values of $f$, the image under $f$ of the points of $M$ at which the manifold derivative of $f$ is not surjective, has Lebesgue measure zero.
nodes.title: Sard's theorem for maps into Euclidean space
